Two days after rc8, this release is mostly what people running rc8 found: Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint now works from embedding to tool calls, a deployment with a restricted database role gets its vector indexes, and a failing embedding model no longer silences chat memory. The first cut of regression cases for the ontology arrives, and the old ontology growth loop is retired.
- Migrations 0109 and 0110, both forward-only, applied on startup. An rc8 database with data (two documents and a pushed stat

- Migrations 0077 to 0079 and 0091 to 0106, all forward-only, applied on startup. An rc7 database with data (two documents and a pushed statement) was migrated by this build with no warnings and read back; a new document and a new push were then processed on it.
- A ClickHouse warehouse can be mounted read-only, with slow queries stopped by the server timeout or `KILL QUERY` (#1094). Databricks and Snowflake results are read to the last chunk and partition (#1063, #1062).

Login takes the same time whether the email or the password is wrong (#867). Worker concurrency falls back to the migration's default (#871). CI runs lint, test and build as parallel jobs behind one aggregator, database-backed tests included, and the store integration tests compile as one binary (#879, #872, #873, #869, #868, #886).
Migrations 0070 to 0076, 0080 and 0090, all forward-only, applied on startup. An rc6 database with data was migrated and read back by this build without warnings.

- [fix] Journal replay #332
